summary: Renames formatPrice to formatMoney in src/money.ts so it formats amounts with Intl.NumberFormat in a chosen currency. Updates invoiceLines to take a currency argument that defaults to USD.

findings.title: Removed export still imported by cart.ts
findings.problem: This change renames the export formatPrice to formatMoney in src/money.ts. src/cart.ts still imports formatPrice and calls it in cartTotal.
findings.consequence: The TypeScript compiler fails to build the project. At runtime, cartTotal throws because formatPrice is undefined, so customers cannot see the cart total.
findings.fix: Update src/cart.ts to import formatMoney and call formatMoney(addTax(subtotal, taxRate), "USD"). Alternatively, keep formatPrice as a wrapper that calls formatMoney with USD.

findings.title: Changed money formatting has no covering test
findings.problem: formatMoney now adds thousands separators and moves the minus sign before the currency symbol. No test in the repository checks formatMoney or invoiceLines.
findings.consequence: Nothing catches a regression in the strings that customers see on invoices.
findings.fix: Add tests for formatMoney and invoiceLines that cover large amounts, negative amounts and a non-USD currency.
